Class AuthFeedbackImpl

java.lang.Object
net.apexes.fetion4j.core.client.AuthFeedbackImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
AuthFeedback
public class AuthFeedbackImpl extends Object implements AuthFeedback
Default implementation of AuthFeedback that coordinates captcha image retrieval and user input via a CountDownLatch.
